scope: All ten GraphQL SDKs: opt-in subscriptions, incremental delivery, scalar codecs and native schema resolution
semantics_verified: Selection-specific variable/result types and retained operation documents
Distinct-connection SSE: next/complete events, partial results, cancellation and malformed framing
Directional scalar callbacks recurse selected fields, named inputs and lists while preserving absence/null
Incremental partial snapshots, deferred object merge and streamed list append; final model decoding does not happen early
Local introspection JSON and full-file imports, missing imports, import cycles and malformed JSON
Required tagged abstract variants in Go/C#/Swift
Provider substitution, deterministic regeneration and existing HTTP package contracts
limitations: SSE distinct connections only: no WebSocket, multiplexing, replay or reconnect
Experimental path-based multipart deferSpec=20220824 only; newer pending/completed ID protocols are rejected
Multipart fixtures simulate this dialect with GraphQL.js execution results; GraphQL.js16 is not a native defer/stream executor
TypeScript incremental generation exposes raw operation functions, without query-hook/mock/validator auxiliaries
Incremental abstract selections require a common unconditional non-deferred __typename; aliases supported
Java/C#/Swift scalar callbacks remain in their native JSON value domains; Python/PHP/Ruby model scalar annotations remain Any/mixed/untyped
Introspection is local-file only; full-file imports supported, selective named imports unsupported
Postman and generated CLI outputs remain query/mutation-only
Historical 205-test guru and release reports were not re-executed or rewritten for this batch
resolved_verification_findings: Schema-only GraphQL block references were aligned with the document revision hash; public-block tests caught and verified the mismatch
Imported operation documents now advance both retained-document and operation-contract revisions
Local npm tests first needed the existing Go OpenAPI compiler binary built
Native addon builds now replace the binary atomically to avoid macOS code-signature cache invalidation when overwriting a loaded library
Default PHP GraphQL tests require PHP 8.2 on PATH or POOLSTER_TEST_PHP; the complete workspace rerun uses pinned PHP/Ruby container wrappers
ignored_test_policy: Default workspace ignored tests are counted separately. Explicit capability runs enable relevant ignored native tests; ignored does not mean passed.
